svg.title: One observer architecture, two physical branches
svg.desc: A source-selected twelve-port carrier federation settles a public normal form. For every supplied order/frame packet, an exact finite theorem composes authenticated local links, the rank-three quotient and its algebraic two-sphere of null-ray labels, supplied frames and cones into order, rank and rest-metric identities. A separate same-carrier theorem works inside a supplied pre-existing 3+1 tensor algebra and uses nine supplied balances on fixed algebraic inverse images of its coordinate tomography frame to derive all-null balance and a finite Einstein-form tensor relation. The distinguished nine-set is neither selected by provenance/source dynamics nor invariant as a set under Lorentz or SO(3) transformations. The informational order is bundled on that carrier but is not used in the tensor calculation; no provenance link selects a direction, field, step, or balance. Neither packet nor premise bundle is constructed, and event dimension is not derived. A physical four-dimensional reading additionally requires dense isotropic link coverage, count-to-volume calibration, manifoldlikeness, and refinement preserving order, directions, and density while gluing rank-three neighborhoods into cubic carrier-ball growth. An imposed FCC/O_h fixture has bounded exact carrier-ball matches on checked radii r=0..20 and fine-carrier matches on checked n=1..10, plus a bounded ordering fraction whose Myrheim-Meyer value is only its inversion; its depth-24 and matched-profile controls fail, so it does not close that condition. A separate required bridge leads to the icosahedral current and Standard Model branch.

g.text: schedule-independent only under the consensus receipts
packet: exact order↔cone + rank/rest; order not tensor input
9 fixed-frame balances in supplied 3+1 → finite Einstein-form; not curvature
#I/ρ → Vol(I), not public N; refinement-preserved: required
FCC/Oh: checked r≤20/n≤10 matches; r→MM only
route identity, attachment, and inhabited-tower receipts are required
